title: Study Finds Trump-Era Tariffs Drove Up Consumer Prices Ahead of Midterms
detail: A new study provides fresh empirical evidence that Trump administration tariffs drove up prices for consumer goods, adding to the economic debate ahead of the November midterms. The findings suggest the inflationary impact of tariff policy remains a key issue for voters as Republicans defend their House majority.

title: Trump Signs Trilateral Agreement with Denmark and Greenland, Expanding US Military Presence
detail: President Trump signed a trilateral agreement with the Prime Ministers of Denmark and Greenland, formalizing an expansion of US military presence in Greenland. The deal marks a significant diplomatic development following months of Trump administration pressure on Denmark over Greenland's strategic Arctic positioning. Details of the basing arrangements and force levels were not immediately disclosed.
